_comment: Translation guard cases shared by the macOS and Windows tests (Prompts.translationFallback). target is a TranslationTarget id: a listed language's code, or a name typed in. The legitimate translations keep names and terms as they are; the rest came back untranslated, in another language, as an answer or as a summary. translatePromptSHA256 is the SHA-256 of the translate prompt's template (Prompts.baseTranslatePrompt, UTF-8), so both apps send the same text.
